claim: Coco Connect is the Mac app that plugs Coco into the AI coding tools on your machine and runs the M0 memory daemon they share.
Finds the AI coding tools installed on your Mac and shows which ones are connected.
Turns each module on, checks its health and disconnects it again; it reports only what it has checked, never a guess.
Runs the M0 memory daemon on your own machine only, behind a token, so tools reach your memory and nothing else does.
Native app for Apple Silicon Macs on macOS 12 or newer.
Per-tool connectors: a capture door and a read door for Cursor, Pi, Codex and more, each one removable on its own.
Codex turns flowing into M0: built and tested, next to go live.
Safe wiring: connecting a tool never overwrites a setting that tool already has.
Beta: 0.9.0-beta is the latest tagged build, for Apple Silicon Macs.
